text:
marco.g: Heads up — our new CLI sample that streams generator output on Ctrl-C behaves oddly. Hitting ctrl-c once sometimes stops cleanly, other times the CLI prints a trailing token and the process hangs until the server times out.

taylor.l: can you paste the snippet? I suspect shutdown vs cancel semantics.

marco.g: minimal form: 
```go
ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt)
defer cancel()
stream, _ := client.Generator().Stream(ctx, req)
for {
  ch, err := stream.Recv()
  if err != nil { break }
  fmt.Print(ch.Text)
}
```
On interrupt we call cancel(); sometimes Recv returns io.EOF immediately, other times it returns a last chunk and then blocks.

sara.q: we've seen this with background send loops that aren't watching ctx.Done. Also, our auth refresh middleware opens a small write when refreshing which can delay cancel delivery.

taylor.l: two UX fixes: 1) example should select on ctx.Done() around Recv so main goroutine can exit immediately; 2) SDK should provide Stream.CloseWithError to signal an explicit error cause and unblock Recv reliably.

marco.g: I tried this pattern: 
```go
for {
  select {
  case <-ctx.Done():
    _ = stream.CloseWithError(ctx.Err())
    return ctx.Err()
  default:
  }
  ch, err := stream.Recv()
  if err != nil { return err }
  fmt.Print(ch.Text)
}
```
This made behavior consistent locally. But CloseWithError doesn't exist in the current SDK so I hacked a Close() and a write of a sentinel message.

sara.q: runtime team: we should not rely on client hacks. Recv semantics need to be: never return non-nil chunk when err != nil, and honor CloseWithError so callers get context.Canceled immediately. Also disable automatic mid-stream auth retries — surface 401 instead of replaying tail fragments.

taylor.l: agree. small note for ergonomics: make CloseWithError idempotent and safe to call from signal handlers. Also add a small CLI sample in quickstarts showing signal.NotifyContext + CloseWithError.

marco.g: filing a tiny PR with the CLI sample and tests that run with -race and pprof. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/482 (WIP)

deploy-bot: CI: go-integration/stream-cancel (linux/race) started by marco.g

sara.q: once runtime exposes CloseWithError I can change middleware to not trigger auth refresh writes while a stream is open. That should prevent the latency windows where cancel is delayed.

taylor.l: also document "streaming is non-retriable" for generator endpoints in the SDK docs — that will help set expectations for onboarding.

marco.g: thanks. I'll keep the sample pinned in quickstarts until the API is stable. Will follow up with the PR link when green. :rocket:
